scope: Prospective performance follow-up; no generator edits and no speedup claim. Profile was concurrent with offline replay.
findings: recordSplitAttempt verifies before prepareSplitVowelTransaction verifies the same successful attempt again.
recordCompletionAttempt verifies before prepareCompletionTransaction verifies the same selected attempt again.
splitAttempts and completionAttempts are always allocated and cloned; shared attempt histories already depend on retainHistory.
constraints: Preserve public transaction authentication and rejection of forged or stale attempts.
Preserve required live construction/certificate ownership when trace is off.
Keep full trace contents and ordering unchanged when trace is on.
Keep completion pass boundary and repeated-pass rejection.
Prove same full words, traces, RNG calls and next draws against the frozen candidate.
Rerun fixed fresh paired performance workload without concurrent diagnostics; do not extrapolate profile percentages into speedup.
possibleDesign: Route formed/selected attempts through the transaction verifier once, keeping verification for noncommitting attempts. Separate history-only attempt retention from counters/state required for runtime invariants. Validate both changes independently.
